{{Vanilla|Rail}}
{{Infobox auto}}
A '''rail''' is a track block that minecarts run on. [[Matcha Flavoured]] replaces its recipe with one that gives more when made from steel.

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
6 iron ingots and a stick make 32 rails, where vanilla makes 16; 6 [[Steel Alloy|steel alloy]] and a stick make 64. The vanilla recipe is removed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/rail_from_iron.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref>

{{Uses|none=A rail is not an ingredient in any recipe; it works as in vanilla.}}
